catalog.hero_subtitle: Iziboniso ze-geometry ye-Euclidean 2D & 3D ne-trigonometri ezisebenzisanako ezinobufakazi bezibalo nokuqapha ubunjalo bemvelo.

steps.deriv-2d-step-5: I-Right Angle ku-P: I-Isosceles ye-Euclidean ne-Dot Product
steps.deriv-3d-step-3: I-Great Circle ye-3D engatjhintjhiko ne-Spatial Orthogonality
steps.cq-step-4: Amabili Aqopeneko Wesibili (B + D = 180°) neSamba Soke
steps.tr-step-2: I-Vector ekhomba lapho i-Tangent iya khona
steps.uch-step-3: I-Tangent yangaphandle ne-Secant Duality (1 + tan²θ = sec²θ)
steps.los-step-2: Isilinganiso samacala kuma-Sine aqopeneko / UmThetho we-Sine ku-S²
steps.loc-step-2: I-Bilinear Interaction Correction (-2ab cos C) / UmThetho we-Cosine ku-S²
steps.loc-step-3: Ukuboniswa kwama-Angle a-Obtuse na-Acute / UmKhawulo we-Taylor
steps.loc-step-4: Ukuwa kwe-Right Angle / I-Excess ka-Girard ne-Area ye-Sphere
steps.asi-step-1: Ukwakheka kwe-SO(3) Euler / Ama-Triangle ane-Right Angle ahlanganisiweko
steps.asi-step-2: I-Orthonormal Triad ne-Metric Invariance / Ifomula yokuhlanganisa i-Sine
steps.asi-step-3: I-Planar SO(2) Subgroup / Ifomula yokuhlanganisa i-Cosine
steps.asi-step-4: I-Trace ye-Lie Algebra ne-Rotation Angle / I-SO(2) Matrix Composition
steps.asi-step-5: I-Volume ye-Parallelepiped ne-Scalar Triple Product (det R = +1)

thales-theorem.title: UmThetho ka-Thales
thales-theorem.description: Rhubhulula bonyana kubayini nanyana ngiyiphi ikona eyakhiwe yi-diameter emaphethelweni we-sidiriki iyikona enqophileko (90°).

angle-at-centre.title: UmThetho we-Kona e-Phakathi
angle-at-centre.description: Bonisa bonyana ikona eyakhiwe yi-arc phakathi nendawo iphindwe kabili ngobukhulu bekona eyakhiwe emaphethelweni we-sidiriki.

angles-in-same-segment.title: Amakona a-Segimendeni e-Fanako
angles-in-same-segment.description: Fakazela bonyana amakona a-segimendeni efanako ye-sidiriki ayakhiwe yi-chord efanako alingana ncamashi.

cyclic-quadrilateral.title: UmThetho we-Cyclic Quadrilateral
cyclic-quadrilateral.description: Fakazela bonyana amakona aqaleneko e-cyclic quadrilateral ebhalwe ngekhephu enza isamba esiqinileko se-180°.

tangent-radius.title: Ukunqopha kwe-Tangent ne-Radius
tangent-radius.description: Bonisa bonyana umuda we-tangent kunanyana ngiliphi iphuzu le-sidiriki unqophile (90°) ku-radius endaweni yokuthintana.

alternate-segment.title: UmThetho we-Segimende e-Tjhugulukako
alternate-segment.description: Rhubhulula bonyana kubayini ikona ephakathi kwe-tangent ne-chord edlula ephuzwini lokuthintana ilingana nekona esegimendeni etjhugulukako.

tangents-from-external-point.title: Iin-Tangent Eziphuma e-Phuzwini Lange-Ndle
tangents-from-external-point.description: Bonisa bonyana iin-tangent ezimbili ezidonselwe ku-sidiriki kusukela ephuzwini linye langaphandle zilingana ngobude begodu zakha i-cyclic kite.

perpendicular-chord-bisector.title: Umsiki O-Perpendicular we-Chord
perpendicular-chord-bisector.description: Fakazela bonyana umsiki o-perpendicular wananyana ngiyiphi i-chord udlula phakathi kwe-sidiriki begodu uhlukanisa i-arc kabili.

unit-circle-helix.title: I-Unit Circle, Imisebenzi e-Tjhuphe ye-Trig Namaza we-Helix 3D
unit-circle-helix.formula: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1  |  r(θ) = (R cos θ, y(θ), R sin θ)
unit-circle-helix.description: Rhubhulula izilinganiso ze-trigonometri eziboniswe phezu kwamaza we-helix e-cylinder 3D ngebonda lokubikezela i-harmonic.

law-of-sines.title: UmThetho wama-Sine ne-Circumcircle Invariant
law-of-sines.formula: a / sin A = b / sin B = c / sin C = 2R
law-of-sines.description: Fakazela isilinganiso sobude bamahlangothi kuma-sine aqaleneko silingana ne-circumdiameter 2R, sithintana nejometri ye-spherical ku-S².

law-of-cosines.title: UmThetho wama-Cosine Nokuboniswa Okuvamileko kwe-Pythagoras
law-of-cosines.description: Zwisisa umthetho ka-Pythagoras owandisiweko one-rectangle yokuhlangana ye-bilinear nomthetho we-cosine we-spherical.

angle-sum-identities.title: Isamba se-Kona, Umehluko Nokuhlanganiswa kwe-Matrix ye-Rotation
angle-sum-identities.description: Thola amafomula wekhompawundi ye-sine ne-cosine kusukela kuma-triangle ane-kona eqondileko ahlanganisiweko namafreyimu we-rotation e-SO(3) Euler.

cookie.title: Iinketho ze-Privacy nama-Cookies
cookie.text: I-Visual Mathematics Lab isebenzisa i-analytics yezobuthekniki ehlanganisiweko evikela i-privacy ukuze iqaphele ukusebenza kwe-app, ubukhulu besikrini, nokuthembeka kwezibalo. I-analytics iyasebenza ngokwendalo, kodwa ungaphuma ngananyana ngisiphi isikhathi.
